episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a brutal attack, Jung Soo In learns she may not be the same person as before. Choi Jun Kyung discovers the monsters are forming an organization.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Looking for his sister, Sul Kang Woo investigates Saejin Church, where he finds Soo In. But he soon encounters trouble — and the two fight to escape.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After raiding Saejin Church, Jun Kyung begins suspecting Kim Chul Min is hiding something — later tracking him down meeting with Soo In and Kang Woo.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: After revealing everything he knows to Chul Min, Kang Woo agrees to help save Soo In. But when the plan goes awry, lives are put at risk.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Despite being on the run, Soo In tries to warn Jun Kyung. But as Team Grey's raid plays out, Soo In and Kang Woo realize it's all part of a bigger plan.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Soo In meets with Sul Kyung Hee, who requests an alliance. But the parasites' ploy for power goes into full effect — and it's up to Heidi to stop them.
